quoted_fields.failure: Product independence is required BETWEEN A and B, with equal finite mode count and finite energy. Correlated A/B inputs, a shared quantum reference, infinite mode count, infinite gain, equality uniqueness and acquired physical state/channel interfaces are outside the accepted scope. Existing false dilation, shared-reference, spectral-majorization, replica, Fisher and determinant shortcuts remain distinct failures and are not accepted here. The later W49 heated log-tail special-class audit/fixed-shift correction and its contrary general-status assertion remain visible as separate source history; it does not audit or identify a defect in the exact cfdb manuscript. Formal certification of this active-channel theorem, external/journal review, historical priority, physical measurement/device operation and matched practical advantage retain their actual supplied statuses; none is inferred from internal acceptance or publication.
quoted_fields.interface: For every finite integer n>=1, two n-mode finite-energy input groups rho_A and rho_B form the product rho_A tensor rho_B. Arbitrary correlations and entanglement WITHIN either input group are allowed. Finite energy means finite mean total photon number in each group. The quantum-limited phase-insensitive amplifier has any fixed finite gain G>1 and retained annihilators c_j=sqrt(G)*a_j+sqrt(G-1)*b_j^dagger. Natural-log von Neumann entropy is measured in nats; N(rho)=g^(-1)(S(rho)/n), g(r)=(r+1)ln(r+1)-r ln r. This is a mathematical state/channel specification, not an acquired preparation, entropy oracle or experimental interface.
